title: PyTorch is not installed in this Python
hint: Open the Setup tab and click Create environment (or choose the PRISMT environment).

title: Python cannot find PRISMT's code
hint: Open the Setup tab and click Check again; if it persists, click Create environment.

title: A Python package is missing
hint: Recreate the PRISMT environment (Setup tab, Create environment).

title: The GPU ran out of memory
hint: Use a smaller preset, a smaller batch size, wider time bins, or more time bins per token.

pattern: no kernel image is available|CUDA driver version is insufficient|NVIDIA driver on your system is too old
title: PyTorch does not match this computer's GPU or driver
hint: Install the PyTorch build for your CUDA version (see docs/cluster.md), or run on the CPU.

title: The computer ran out of memory
hint: Use fewer trials (Trials per session), wider time bins, or run on the cluster.

title: Two copies of a math library were loaded
hint: Recreate the PRISMT environment; do not mix conda and pip installs of numpy and torch.

pattern: GLIBCXX_[0-9.]+' not found|Library not loaded|DLL load failed
title: A system library conflict stopped Python
hint: Recreate the PRISMT environment. If it persists, start MATLAB from a terminal.

title: PRISMT could not write to the run folder
hint: Choose a project folder you can write to.
